g.data-exception-reason: Native single-height dot layouts replace continuous line and fill footprints inside this master. Route rows meet marker perimeter rows with ordinary dot spacing; walls keep the same centreline.1.2mm dot width gives0.4mm less outer reach than a2mm continuous stroke. Filled table retains exact24x20mm extent.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse all current continuous geometry through local references. Route, start and destination retain one principal raised level for uninterrupted tracing. Room wall uses principal relief and the separate filled table uses a lower area role. Only the profile paint/height roles change; no new geometry exception is required for ViewPlus.
